pathways.title: 10th → 12th (PCM) → B.E/B.Tech (Computer Science) → Jobs/PG
steps: 12th → Appear for TNEA / JEE / State counselling
Enroll B.E/B.Tech Computer Science via TNEA or entrance exams
pathways.notes: Strong route for Chennai IT jobs, scholarships available via state and central schemes

pathways.title: 10th → 12th (Any) → Diploma/UG in Design → Agencies/Freelance
steps: Apply for design diplomas or B.Des
pathways.notes: Affordable pathways: private diplomas, community college tie-ups

pathways.title: 10th → 12th (PCM) → B.Tech/B.Sc CS → Specialized M.Tech/Certifications
steps: Join AI teams or research labs
pathways.notes: Consider certification scholarships and part-time projects

pathways.title: 10th → Diploma in IT/Computer → Lateral Entry to Degree or Jobs
steps: Lateral entry to 2nd year B.E via counselling / join workforce
pathways.notes: Good for budget-conscious students seeking quick entry to IT roles

pathways.title: 12th Commerce → CA Foundation → Articleship → CA
steps: Enroll for CA Foundation and coaching
pathways.notes: Long path but high ROI; scholarships and instalment options exist

pathways.title: 12th / Degree → TNPSC / State Exam Preparation → Government Service
steps: Join state coaching or self-study with TNPSC materials
pathways.notes: TNPSC has reserved quota and coaching support in many districts

pathways.title: 10th → ITI Trade → Apprenticeship → Skilled Worker / Small Business
steps: Complete trade course and practical training
Start as technician or small enterprise
pathways.notes: Fast route to employment with strong local demand

pathways.title: 10th → 12th → B.Sc Agriculture / Diploma → Field Work / Extension
steps: Consider agricultural diplomas or B.Sc Agri
Engage with Krishi Vigyan Kendra and state schemes
Work in field extension or agritech startups
pathways.notes: High relevance in Tamil Nadu rural districts

pathways.title: 12th → Undergraduate → B.Ed → Teaching Jobs / Coaching
steps: Apply for government or private school jobs
pathways.notes: Stable demand and local opportunities; scholarships for education students
